config.seed_rule: seed(shape, rep i) = seed_base + seed_offsets[shape] + i (identical subsamples to run_ph_resampling.py)
config.varied: input sample only (NOT cover parameters; see baseline E2 for the parameter-sensitivity question)

cyclomatic_number_definition: cyclomatic number = E - V + C (edges minus vertices plus connected components) = the number of independent cycles of an undirected graph; graph cycles are not automatically topological loops in the data (baseline no-loop control caveat).
similarity_caveat: S is a custom exploratory overlap indicator (symmetric mean of best membership-Jaccard matches), not a metric and not a canonical Mapper graph similarity; it is greedy, edge-blind, and not normalized for node count, so it must not be used to rank graphs across different cover resolutions. Read it only against the pre-specified reference cell, beside component counts and representative graphs.
global_identity_note: All membership comparisons use GLOBAL point ids (indices into the full baseline point cloud). Local subsample row indices from different subsamples are never compared.

structure.cycles_caveat: Mapper graph cycles are not automatically equivalent to true topological loops in the data: the no-loop control produces short noise-scale graph cycles while its H1 diagram correctly shows no dominant class. Cycle length and scale context distinguish loop-like structure from noise.
